description: Internal: configuration-change handler (paste-a-key) that refreshes settings and fans out provider model discovery.

request_schema.description: Configuration-change event delivered to `router::on_config_changed` via the engine's `configuration` trigger (paste-a-key flow).

id.description: Configuration id; the handler only acts on `llm-router`.

response_schema.description: Generic acknowledgement returned by trigger-bound handlers whose result is not consumed by callers (kept typed so the response schema is concrete).
response_schema.title: RouterAck
